swap_risks: HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: LM2904DR has a lower Vs,abs,max rating (26 V, p.4) than LM358DR2G (32 V, p.3); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 26 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 70% higher on LM358DR2G (LM2904DR: 124.7 °C/W p.5 vs LM358DR2G: 212 °C/W p.3); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (LM2904DR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial / Automotive Temp (-40°C to +125°C TA) vs LM358DR2G: 0..70 °C Commercial (0°C to +70°C)); LM358DR2G cold limit only 0 °C, LM358DR2G hot limit only 70 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: LM2904DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) and LM358DR2G (onsemi, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because Vs,abs,max drops >=15% (26 V vs 32 V); θJA worsens 70% (thermal derating verification required); ambient temperature grade differs (-40..125 °C vs 0..70 °C). Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 0.7 MHz (p.11) vs 1 MHz (p.6), supply ceiling 26 V (p.5) vs 30 V (p.4), Vos 7 mV (p.11) vs 7 mV (p.4), Ib 2x gap (20000 vs 45000 pA). Primary bench gotchas to watch: LM2904DR "Hidden 26 V Supply Ceiling Trap When Swapping From 30 V/32 V LM358DR to 'Extended-Temp' LM2904DR!" (p.4) and LM358DR2G "CRITICAL ESD Trap: Standard onsemi LM358DR2G Is Rated ONLY 250 V HBM / 100 V MM (p.3)!" (p.3). BOM decision: Choose LM2904DR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOIC-8 (D (8-Pin SOIC)) qualification and -40..125 °C grade; choose LM358DR2G when supply rails exceed 26 V (rated up to 30 V). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.1) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
